summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Clients Page Revamp + /clients-enriched endpoint. All 16 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: new master-detail layout with top portfolio metric strip (6 tiles), master list with search/filters/client items, detail pane with tabs and Quick Actions. All data-testid attributes present and working.

minor.issue: ClientCreate model doesn't include 'tier' and 'lifecycle' fields - these are set via enriched endpoint defaults only

critical_code_review_comments: Health Score Breakdown in Overview tab shows all zeros (0) - the breakdown values from _calc_health are not being passed to the frontend detail view. The detail endpoint /api/clients/{id} doesn't include breakdown, only /api/clients/{id}/health does.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 20 clients, Acme Corporation (client-001) linked to Acronis + Pax8
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 104 tested the Clients Page Revamp. Backend endpoint GET /api/clients-enriched returns {summary, clients[]} with all required fields. Summary has: client_count (20), total_mrr ($39,900), avg_health (73.4), at_risk (5), churned (0), prospects (0), with_acronis (1), with_pax8 (1). Each client has: id, name, industry, tier, lifecycle, health_score, risk_level, mrr, mrr_trend (12 months), open_tickets, asset_count, assets_online, contact_count, overdue_count, overdue_amount, active_contracts, integrations.{acronis,pax8,m365,rmm}, last_activity, primary_contact, email, phone, address. Frontend ClientsPage.jsx (~615 lines) has: data-testid=clients-page, clients-search-input, filter-lifecycle, filter-risk, filter-integration, new-client-btn, client-list-item-{id}, client-detail-pane, tab-overview/tickets/assets/contacts/billing/integrations/activity, create-client-btn, new-client-name. Keyboard shortcuts: '/' focuses search, 'j'/'k' navigates list, Cmd/Ctrl-N opens new client dialog. Quick Actions link to /tickets?clientId={id}, /invoices?clientId={id}. Detail tabs deep-link to respective pages with clientId query param.
